text.full-desc:
Non è la solita gita in barca, è una giornata indimenticabile firmata Amico Fabio. Salperemo verso il Parco Nazionale di Ras Mohammed, dove il deserto incontra il mare più blu che abbiate mai visto. 

La tappa principale? L'Isola Bianca (Isola che non c'è): una lingua di sabbia bianca che appare e scompare con la marea, creando una piscina naturale degna delle Maldive. 

Tra un tuffo e l'altro, il nostro chef di bordo preparerà un pranzo a buffet fresco e gustoso. Che tu voglia esplorare i fondali con le nostre guide esperte o semplicemente abbronzarti sul ponte sole, questa è l'escursione perfetta per combinare avventura e totale relax.
text.highlights: Sosta esclusiva all'Isola Bianca (L'Isola che non c'è)2 tappe snorkeling sulla barriera corallina più bella del mondoPranzo fresco a bordo con bevande illimitateAtmosfera rilassata: Niente folla, solo divertimento
text.important: Porta con te: Passaporto (obbligatorio), telo mare, crema solare, occhiali da sole e tanta voglia di divertirti. In inverno porta una felpa leggera per il rientro.

text.desc: Experience the 'Egyptian Caribbean' aboard a luxury yacht. Snorkeling, relaxation, and gourmet lunch in the National Park.
text.excludes: Snorkeling equipment rental (mask/fins - optional)Professional photo/video serviceTips (at your discretion)
text.full-desc:
It’s not just another boat trip, it’s an unforgettable day signed by Amico Fabio. We will set sail to Ras Mohammed National Park, where the desert meets the bluest sea you’ve ever seen. 

The main stop? White Island: a tongue of white sand that appears and disappears with the tide, creating a natural pool worthy of the Maldives. 

Between dives, our onboard chef will prepare a fresh and tasty buffet lunch. Whether you want to explore the seabed with our expert guides or just sunbathe on the sun deck, this is the perfect excursion to combine adventure and total relaxation.
text.highlights: Exclusive stop at the White Island (The Neverland Island)2 snorkeling stops on the world's most beautiful coral reefFresh lunch on board with unlimited drinksRelaxed atmosphere: No crowds, just fun
text.important: Bring with you: Passport (mandatory), beach towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, and lots of energy. In winter, bring a light sweatshirt for the return.
text.includes: R/T Hotel transfer (A/C Bus)Ras Mohammed National Park entry ticketBuffet lunch prepared on boardUnlimited soft drinks all dayItalian-speaking Snorkeling guide
text.program: 08:00VIP PickupOur private transfer will pick you up directly at the hotel. No stress.09:00Boarding and WelcomeArrival at the port, quick check-in, and welcome on board with a safety briefing.10:30Snorkeling at Ras MohammedFirst guided stop to admire millenary corals and colorful fish.12:30Magic White IslandLanding on the famous white sand spit. Free time for Instagrammable photos and relaxation in the water.13:30Lunch with a ViewRich buffet on board (fish, meat, rice, salads) freshly prepared by the chef.14:30Last Dive or RelaxationSecond snorkeling stop or time to enjoy the sun while we sail.16:30ReturnReturn to the port and comfortable transfer back to your hotel.
text.title: Ras Mohammed & White Island: The VIP Experience
